title: Customer addresses
description: The saved addresses of people who have ordered from this shop. Read-only: each person keeps their own address book.

help.title: About Customer addresses
help.overview: Every person keeps one address book, on every site they sign in to. This page lists the books of the people who have ordered here, so staff can look an address up. Changing one is up to its owner; an order keeps its own copy of the address it was shipped to.

sections.title: What is listed
items: Every saved address of each person with at least one order in this shop.
The person, the type (billing or shipping) and the default marker are shown with the address.
